text: She did not stop to ask. <break time="0.8s" /> Whether the joy that held her. <break time="0.8s" /> Was a monstrous one. <break time="0.8s" /> For she felt. <break time="0.8s" /> That the question did not matter. <break time="0.8s" /> She knew. <break time="0.8s" /> That she would weep again. <break time="0.8s" /> When she saw the kind, tender hands. <break time="0.8s" /> Folded in death. <break time="0.8s" /> And the loving face fixed and gray. <break time="0.8s" /> But beyond that bitter moment. <break time="0.8s" /> Lay a long procession of years to come. <break time="0.8s" /> Which would belong to her absolutely. <break time="0.8s" /> She opened and spread her arms out. <break time="0.8s" /> To them in welcome. <break time="0.8s" /> Ready to greet. <break time="0.8s" /> Every one of those coming years. <break time="0.8s" /> There would be no one. <break time="0.8s" /> To live for but herself. <break time="0.8s" /> And no powerful will would ever again bend hers. <break time="0.8s" /> With blind persistence. <break time="0.8s" /> Whether the intention was kind or cruel. <break time="0.8s" /> She now saw. <break time="0.8s" /> That forcing ones will on another person. <break time="0.8s" /> Was no less a crime. <break time="0.8s" /> And yet she had loved him. <break time="0.8s" /> Sometimes though often she had not and in this new moment. <break time="0.8s" /> It hardly seemed to matter at all. <break time="0.8s" /> What could love that unsolved mystery. <break time="0.8s" /> Count for in the face of this self assertion. <break time="0.8s" /> Which she suddenly recognized. <break time="0.8s" /> As the strongest feeling of her being. <break time="0.8s" /> Free Body and soul free. <break time="0.8s" /> She kept whispering to herself. <break time="0.8s" /> As though the words were a prayer.
